run_SPIDER_MJWP_fast_optimization: run the SPIDER MuJoCo Warp optimization script with deterministic best-trajectory replay and retry-revert state machine
run_main_Hydra_entry_point: run the Hydra-configured entry point to execute SPIDER MJWP fast optimization with CLI overrides
main_deterministic_optimization_loop: run the main optimization loop that manages OPTIMIZE, RECOVERING, and DONE states with checkpoint save and restore
apply_boost_retry_parameters: apply progressive retry boost to increase optimization iterations and noise scale by sqrt(2) per boost level
save_config_yaml_output: save the processed SPIDER config to a YAML file in the output directory excluding skipped fields
